description: This file defines a PHP trait named AttendanceRecordPermissionTrait, which provides permission checking functionality for attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It ensures only authorized users can access specific attendance records based on user roles and ownership.

methods.name: checkAttendanceRecordAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the given attendance record is accessible by the current user, throwing a ForbiddenException if access is denied. It verifies the usage context is an Endpoint and confirms user permissions based on roles or if the user is the record owner.
